title: Save runtime firewall changes
summary: Make current temporary firewall changes permanent so they survive a reboot.

steps.explain: Copy the current runtime configuration to the permanent configuration.

rollback.explain: Revert to the previous permanent configuration by reloading firewalld (if you haven't saved yet, this discards runtime changes). If already saved, you must manually undo changes.

warnings: This overwrites the permanent configuration with the current runtime state.
Ensure your current runtime rules are correct before saving.
